common_gotchas: Faceted caps use unique points, while shared caps share points with the original primitive.
Rounded caps add concentric regions and can increase geometry density.
Preserve NURB Shape clamps the surface at the cap point; decide this before expecting the original surface profile to remain unchanged.
Positive and negative scale values change rounded/tangent cap height and direction.
Cap behavior differs between meshes and faces, so verify the primitive type before planning closure.
key_concepts: Cap SOP closes open primitive regions on U and/or V ends.
Cap modes include no cap, faceted, shared, rounded, and tangent-style caps.
Faceted caps create unique points, while shared caps reuse the original primitive points.
Rounded and tangential caps can add cross sections and scaled cap height in the selected direction.
